title: signal-orchestra-standup-fragment-2027-09-14
body:
Context: quick capture from the small-ops standup we had in the whiteboard room. This is not a polished playbook — raw notes and next steps for the "signal orchestra" idea (converging UI telemetry + rollout orchestration + analytics events).

Attendees: Ava, Miguel, Priya, Ellen, Jonas (10:15–10:50).

High-level intent:
- Create a single, composable signal layer that powers canary gates, panel feature gating, and frontend health indicators.
- Reduce mean-time-to-detect regressions in UI rollouts by combining UX telemetry (click/dropoff funnels) with backend serving signals (latency/error-rate) and analytics pipeline backpressure.

Notes / observations:
- Recent canary (panel-v2) showed divergent UX signals despite stable backend p95. Users abandoned the task flow at the 2nd step even though inference latency was within SLO. Hypothesis: small UI change + missing telemetry around intermediate button state.
- Analytics ingestion lag spiked to ~20s during the canary window; that delayed automated rollback by one iteration. Need to capture ingestion lag as a first-class signal.
- Current console dashboards show event counts and token latency, but no derived funnel or sequence-aware metrics (e.g., percent of successful tool calls after panel open).
- E2E synthetic checks only assert page load and high-level success; they miss subtle UX regressions (spinner-to-error transitions, focus trapping).

Short-term actions (this sprint):
1) Small instrumentation sprint (owner: Miguel) — add event-level telemetry for panel interactions: panel.open, panel.step.start, panel.step.complete, panel.step.error. Tag events with rollout_id and canary_cohort. Deadline: 2027-09-21.
2) Ingestion-lag metric (owner: Priya) — emit a heartbeat from frontend with client_ts and compute ingestion_latency in the analytics pipeline, surface in rollout dashboard. Add alert at 10s. Deadline: 2027-09-19.
3) Canary gate update (owner: Ava) — add derived funnel metric to canary gates: % completion from panel.open -> panel.step.complete within 30s. If funnel drops >5% relative to baseline, fail canary. Draft config and RFC by 2027-09-17.
4) Synthetic scenario refresh (owner: Ellen) — add a synthetic that walks the full panel flow including delayed backend responses and asserts no intermediate UI error state. Run every 5m and post results to #console-rollouts. Deadline: 2027-09-20.
5) Analytics backpressure play (owner: Jonas) — add a lightweight fallback for rollout automation if ingestion lag > 15s: pause automatic rollouts and send manual review signal. Prototype in staging by 2027-09-23.

Risks and open questions:
- How do we avoid signal noise from mobile vs desktop differences? Proposal: tag platform and apply cohort-based baselining. Need decision on cohort granularity (owner: Priya).
- Privacy: some events include sequence context; need to ensure nothing PII-leaking. Sync with security/compliance before rolling to production (owner: Ava).
- What threshold is appropriate for funnel deviation? We used 5% as a starting point; ops will validate once we have 2 weeks of baseline.
- Can analytics pipeline carry these high-cardinality rollout_id tags without high-cost cardinality explosion? Jonas to run cost estimate.

Short brainstorm ideas (non-blocking):
- Signal composition DSL: a tiny language to declare derived signals (e.g., funnel(open, complete, window=30s) and join with backend.error_rate). Could be a JSON spec stored with the rollout config.
- Rolling confidence score: combine z-scored delta across multiple signals into a single confidence value used by the automated rollout engine.
- UI quick-retriage feature in console: if canary fails based on funnel, open a contextual diff view that overlays user path heatmap before/after.

Meeting artifacts / references captured:
- Quick diagram sketched on whiteboard (photo uploaded to #console-ops, link in Confluence).
- Miguel linked prototype telemetry schema PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/1602
- Jira epic: CON-9123 (Signal Orchestra instrumentation + rollout integration).

Decisions made in-standup:
- Add ingestion-lag as a required gate signal for all automated rollouts.
- Instrument per-step events on panel flows this sprint.
- Pause autopromote if ingestion lag > 15s (prototype).

Action owners recap:
- Miguel: event instrumentation, PRs for frontend + event-schema.
- Priya: ingestion-lag metric, dashboard tile, alert.
- Ava: canary gate config RFC + compliance sync.
- Ellen: synthetics refresh + runbook update.
- Jonas: analytics cost/cardinality analysis + fallback prototype.

Follow-ups and next meetup:
- Quick sync on progress on 2027-09-21 10:00 (standup slot). Bring check-ins for each action owner (2–3 bullets each).
- Schedule securitiy/compliance 30m review after RFC (Ava to book).

Notes to future self: capture baseline numbers before enabling automation. Keep rollout_id life short (TTL 7 days) to limit cardinality. Consider sampling at 10% for high-cardinality tag sets in production while we evaluate cost.

Raw capture ends here. Convert to RFC and attach the whiteboard photo + PR links before we mark as in_review.
